summary: Rewrites the addBusinessDays loop to step forward one day first and then check whether the day it landed on is a business day. This fixes the listed bug #1. The PR also adds a regression test for weekend landings.

findings.issue: The new test covers only weekend landings. It has no case where the landing day is a holiday, or where a start date on a weekend or holiday is followed by more business days. The existing holiday test only partly covers this. A case such as a Friday holiday with +1 would pin down the other half of #1.
